bridgeUrl.label: Bridge address
bridgeUrl.description: Where the FreeRDP bridge container listens. Empty uses RDP_BRIDGE_URL, or termix-rdp-bridge:30020.

enable.label: Direct RDP
enable.description: Pass the server's own H.264 frames to the browser instead of going through guacd. Needs the bridge container, and the page must be served over HTTPS.

port.label: RDP port
port.description: The port the host listens on for RDP.

enablePrinting.label: Printing
enablePrinting.description: Offer a printer to the session. Off by default: it has only been tried on a few Windows versions.

rdpDirect.insecureContext: Direct RDP needs HTTPS. Browsers only allow video decoding and audio on secure pages, and this one was opened over plain HTTP. Enable SSL on the Termix server (ENABLE_SSL) and open it over https://, or open this host with the RDP tab instead, which decodes on the server.
rdpDirect.noH264: This host draws without H.264, so the session falls back to decoding on the server — it works, but costs far more CPU and bandwidth. Enable "Prioritize H.264/AVC 444 graphics mode" on the target and restart it for the fast path.
rdpDirect.printed: {{name}} was printed on the remote desktop.
rdpDirect.serverDecode: This browser could not decode this host's video, so the session falls back to decoding on the server — it works, but costs far more CPU and bandwidth than the direct path.
rdpDirect.shortcutsEscapeNotice: This browser will not hand over reserved shortcuts such as Ctrl+W and Alt+Tab, even in fullscreen — they still act on the browser. Every other key reaches the remote desktop.

protocol.title: Direct RDP
protocol.description: Remote desktop, decoded in the browser

login.title: Direct RDP login
login.shared: The same Windows account RDP signs in with. Changing it here changes it for RDP too.
